title.en: The export stops being silent for six seconds

highlights.zh: 导出音频时先说“正在准备乐器…”，首次反馈从 6.4 秒缩到 0.1 秒；随后仍是带预计剩余时间的百分比。
highlights.en: An audio export now says "Preparing instruments…" first: the first feedback moved from 6.4 s to 0.1 s, and the percentage with its estimate still follows.

highlights.zh: 那六秒花在取目录与录音上（渲染开始之前），此前这一阶段一声不响；无头渲染早就报同一件事。
highlights.en: Those six seconds were the catalogue and recordings being fetched before the render began, a stage that reported nothing — while the headless path had always narrated it.
